claims.text: The resort sits on a limestone clifftop along the southern coast of the Bukit peninsula.

findings.quote: perched atop the 160-metre limestone clifftop that snakes along the southern coast of the Bukit peninsula

claims.text: The accommodation consists of villas and mansions with private pools and bespoke butler service.

findings.quote: With bespoke butler service, private pools, 59 exclusive villas and mansions

claims.text: The Bvlgari Villa has a heated swimming pool that reaches toward the Indian Ocean and cascades into a second lower pool.

findings.quote: a 20-metre heated swimming pool, which reaches toward the sapphire Indian Ocean and cascades into a second lower pool

claims.text: The Five-Bedroom Mansions have a dedicated separate entrance and sit in tropical gardens with ocean vistas.

findings.quote: with a dedicated separate entrance, the Five-Bedroom Mansions exist in their own enchanted world
Ensconced in mature tropical gardens that reveal ocean vistas

claims.text: The Bvlgari Spa menu combines Asian and European approaches, including an ayurvedic Balinese ritual, facials, body wraps and Balinese massages.

findings.quote: the Spa’s menu is designed to offer a series of complete treatments that integrate Asian and European approaches: the ayurvedic Balinese ritual, facial treatments, body wraps and Balinese massages

claims.text: Private yoga instruction is available around the clock.

findings.quote: private yoga instruction is available around the clock

claims.text: Local village walks are among the complimentary experiences offered.

findings.quote: Further complimentary experiences include local village walks

claims.text: The resort offers flexible check-in and check-out, depending on availability.

findings.quote: offers a flexible check-in and check-out policy in an effort to accommodate early or late arrival and departure requests as often as possible, depending on availability

claims.text: La Spiaggia is a multi-level cafe above the beach serving a lunchtime menu.

findings.quote: La Spiaggia, a breezy multi-level café perched above two-miles of wild white sands
serving a lunchtime menu of tempura-battered soft-shell crab

claims.text: The grounds include a helicopter pad.

findings.quote: include a helicopter pad

claims.text: The Kecak Fire Dance at Uluwatu Temple is a 15-minute drive from the resort.

findings.quote: a 15-minute drive to one of Bali’s most extraordinary attractions, the Kecak Fire Dance
at the westerly Uluwatu Temple

claims.text: Breakfast is available 24 hours a day, served in the villa at no extra charge or at the all-day restaurant Sangkar.

findings.quote: available 24-hours a day, either served in your villa (at no extra charge) or at all-day restaurant Sangkar

claims.text: The design uses local materials such as blackened Javanese mahogany, alang-alang thatch and sukabami stone.

findings.quote: blending local materials such as blackened Javanese mahogany, alang-alang thatch and jade-green sukabami stone

claims.text: Il Ristorante - Nico Romito serves tasting menus in the evening.

findings.quote: At night, guests dress up for tasting menus at Il Ristorante – Nico Romito

claims.text: The spa entrance is an antique Javanese joglo house, and the spa area includes a yoga sala, a fitness center and a second swimming pool.

findings.quote: An intricately carved antique Javanese joglo house serves as the entrance to The Spa, where you’ll find a yoga sala, a fitness center and a second swimming pool

claims.text: Serpenti Beach is protected by a coral reef and is inaccessible to the general public from ground and sea.

findings.quote: inaccessible to the general public from both ground and sea, as it is protected by a coral reef

claims.text: There is no kids club, but activities such as kite-making and Balinese dance are available on request, and babysitting is available.

findings.quote: There’s no kids club but activities such as kite-making and Balinese dance are available on request. Babysitting is also available.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the location is secluded and away from main tourist areas.
